title: Emergency restoration of PolyCopyTrader service startup
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: На бою теперь вообще не стартует, сразу вылетает. Локально запустил - там вот такая картина
Расставь правильно приоритеты. Сервис сейчас не может стартовать, это недопустимо. Поэтому сейчас мы делаем ТОЛЬКО восстановление работы сервиса.

scope.goal: Restore ordinary PolyCopyTrader.Service startup as the only current outcome by correcting the confirmed dependency-injection constructor selection and excluding the incompatible unfinished index edits from the deployment workspace without losing them.
inScope: Make the custom-catalog PostgresSchemaInitializer constructor non-public so production dependency injection can select only the public constructor that loads PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault().

Add one focused regression test that resolves IStorageSchemaInitializer through the production implementation-type registration without registering PostgresSchemaMigration services and without opening a database connection.

Preserve the exact current ix_signals_trader_wallet_id changes from PostgresSchema.cs and StorageTests.cs in a named Git stash, verify their pre-stash hashes and patch identity, and leave those two files clean so Visual Studio build/publish cannot include the incompatible unfinished index work.
Remove the uncommitted Environment.ExitCode change because it does not restore startup and the user's latest instruction limits work to service restoration only.

Run the focused DI regression, existing focused versioned-migration tests against an isolated local PostgreSQL instance, and a complete solution build with all disposable outputs under a marked D:\CodexTemp run.

Commit the minimal repair separately after the existing approval and reapproval checkpoints, validate it mechanically, obtain independent semantic review, and push the existing deployment branch for user deployment.
outOfScope: Adding migration 0002, changing or creating ix_signals_trader_wallet_id, modifying immutable baseline 0001, changing any migration SQL/checksum/history behavior, or completing RC-20260820-add-signals-trader-wallet-index.
Changing fatal-process exit-code behavior, logging behavior, general dependency-injection design, startup configuration, workers, or unrelated code.
Changing production PostgreSQL, creating migration history or an index directly, deploying, publishing, or starting/stopping/restarting the production service.
Changing strategies, signals, bets, orders, Paper/Live execution, stakes, PnL, Dashboard behavior, external APIs, or server configuration.
Dropping or discarding the unfinished index changes; they remain preserved in the exact named Git stash for a later separately approved task.
scope.periodOrFilter: Ordinary PolyCopyTrader.Service startup only; exact excluded working-tree files are src/PolyCopyTrader.Storage/PostgresSchema.cs and tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/StorageTests.cs.
scope.firstVerification: Capture exact hashes and diff of the two unfinished index files, create and verify a path-limited named Git stash containing only those files, then resolve IStorageSchemaInitializer from an isolated ServiceCollection with a dummy 127.0.0.1:1 factory without calling InitializeAsync.

requirements.text: Production dependency injection must construct PostgresSchemaInitializer through its non-empty default migration catalog path.
acceptanceCriteria: PostgresSchemaInitializer exposes exactly one public constructor to production DI, and that constructor calls PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault().
The custom-catalog constructor remains internal and callable by the existing friend test assembly.
Resolving IStorageSchemaInitializer using the same implementation-type registration as Program.cs succeeds without any PostgresSchemaMigration service registration.
The DI regression uses a dummy 127.0.0.1:1 connection string and performs no database or external connection.

verification.expected: Production-shape DI resolution succeeds and existing migration tests pass without changing production.
